sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Healomax Stress Assessment”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Use the [stress_assess] shortcode on any page or post

Manual Installation

  1. Download the healomax-stress-assessment.zip file
  2. Upload the file to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP
  3. Extract the files in the plugins directory
  4. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  5. Use the [stress_assess] shortcode on any page or post to display the form

Quick Setup

  1. Go to Settings > Stress Assessment in your WordPress admin
  2. Add your optional services and contact details
  3. Save changes
  4. Add [stress_assess] shortcode to any page where you want the assessment to appear
  5. Your stress assessment is now live and ready to generate leads!
sections.faq:
How quickly can I start generating leads with this plugin?

You can have your stress assessment live and generating leads within 5 minutes of installation. Simply activate the plugin and add the [stress_assess] shortcode to any page.

Do I need coding skills to use this plugin?

No coding skills required! The plugin uses a simple shortcode system that works with any WordPress theme. Just add [stress_assess] where you want the assessment to appear.

How accurate are the stress assessment results?

Our assessment uses a scientifically-designed questionnaire that provides reliable stress level analysis. The results are based on established psychological research and provide meaningful insights for users.

Can I customize the assessment results with my own branding?

Yes! You can add your services, contact information, phone number, email, and physical address to the results page, making it a powerful lead generation and branding tool.

How do users view their assessment results?

Results are displayed immediately on the same page after users complete the assessment. This instant gratification increases engagement and conversion rates.

Can I use this plugin on multiple websites?

Absolutely! You can install and use this free plugin on unlimited websites without any additional fees or licensing restrictions.

What happens to the user data collected?

The plugin displays results directly to users on your website. You can configure it to collect contact information for follow-up based on your privacy policy and local regulations.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes! The assessment form and results are fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices, tablets, and desktop computers.

Can organizations use this for employee wellness programs?

Definitely! Many organizations use our plugin to conduct stress assessments among employees and create healthier work environments.

What kind of ROI can I expect?

Many professionals report generating $100-$5000+ in new client value per assessment. With conversion rates of 15-25%, this plugin typically pays for itself immediately (and it’s free!).
